calls.title: Growthbook <> Pizza Express - Intro
calls.summary: GrowthBook's Daniel Wathne and Logan Bates introduced their experimentation and feature flagging platform to Pizza Express's Ross Pyres (customer technology director), Stephen Clay (technical product manager), and Jason (product ops and analytics). The team discussed replacing their expensive Optimizely contract with GrowthBook’s warehouse-native integration with Snowflake, its flexibility for both developer-coded and visual editor experiments, and the need to reduce costs while improving developer experience during their replatforming. Next steps include upgrading their existing free trial to an enterprise instance, connecting Snowflake, and coordinating with the data warehouse team before a follow-up call.

calls.title: Growthbook <> Pizza Express - Commercial Review
calls.summary: GrowthBook's Daniel Wathne presented enterprise and pro pricing options to Pizza Express, addressing their need to replace Optimizely while controlling costs and handling high CDN request volumes. Key participants were Daniel (GrowthBook sales), Ross Pyres (decision-maker), and Stephen Clay (technical user). Next steps: Daniel will send a revised enterprise proposal near $29,600 and standard terms; Ross will review internally and respond within 24 hours.
